description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ethical principles discussed within the MedEthicsQA dataset. The chart contains twelve slices, each representing a different ethical principle. The slices are labeled as follows: “Recognize the Responsibility to the Occupation” (dark blue), “Comply with Laws and Regulations” (light blue), “Promote Environmental Sustainability and Public Education” (green), “Promote Patient and Family Sources Fairly” (orange), “Treat Patient When Providing Medical Care” (red), “Prevent Patient from Harm” (yellow), “Maintain Qualified Care” (light orange), “Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain” (brown), “Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve” (dark orange), “Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement” (purple), “Keep Patient’s Information Confidential” (pink), and “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Decisions-making of Patient, Freedom of Choice” (gray). The chart includes a legend alongside it, listing each principle with its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices, but the slices appear to be ordered roughly from largest to smallest proportion, with “Recognize the Responsibility to the Occupation” appearing as the largest segment and “Respect Patient’s Rights to be Informed, Decisions-making of Patient, Freedom of Choice” as the smallest. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
